body.content: Hypothesize a 'Diversity-Efficiency Frontier': There is a mathematical trade-off where increasing a system's resilience to correlated failure requires a proportional decrease in its operational efficiency (due to the cost of maintaining non-standardized stacks). This suggests that the most 'resilient' system is intentionally 'sub-optimal' from a traditional engineering perspective.
body.why_keep_this: Provides a theoretical framework for why decentralized systems are resilient despite being 'worse' at individual service management.
